scope: Untrusted whole-function equality construction from scoped local semantic applications; ordinary proof replay remains mandatory.
proofs: Use retains concrete law arguments and all application premise certificates.
Forall introduces fresh binders and opens both arguments and nested premise terms in the application scope.
Cases preserves choose/and/or branch facts; congruence lifts other expression children.
Balanced transitivity retains original step order within each function.
Whole-function laws use exact source/portable definition contexts before guarded-choice authoring.

parity.scope: Nested lambdas, repeated local rewrites, branch/lazy-Boolean premises, guarded whole-function composition, empty inputs and guard boundaries. No performance or GPU claim.

limits: Only pure semantic function roots are composed.
Ambient entry contracts, call postconditions and known let-argument facts may require further proof proposals; unsupported compositions fail ordinary replay.
Bounded application/path/proof work can decline large proposals.
Conformance does not establish profitability; mixed-grid selection experiment remains pending.
